text: Revisit: generalize claude-instances from claude-only into a <agentic-runner> x <model> session dashboard. scan.sh currently hard-codes one provider (ps 'claude' + ~/.claude/projects transcripts; a session == a transcript file, a running proc makes it 'live'). Three options assessed 2026-07-06: (1) CHEAPEST — an 'lm/q calls' panel reading ~/Code/local-models JSONL histories (one-shot calls, not live sessions, so a separate panel); (2) CLEANEST — extract a session-provider interface {enumerate procs by pattern; locate transcript dir/format; parse tail -> {model,state,activity}} so codex/aider drop in as providers; (3) codex works when installed (~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl + ps 'codex'); antigravity is IDE-embedded, needs investigation. Origin: this session's scan.sh pgrep->ps fix (776f97d). At the weekly audit, decide whether to build (1) and/or (2). [TIME-BOXED at the 2026-07-12 weekly review: decide by 2026-07-19 — build option (1) and/or (2), defer to a named milestone, or close. Undecided by then = raise at the 2026-07-19 weekly review as a forced pick.]
